boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain College of Saint Benedict
boards.description: Explore the essential late-night study spots, dining halls, and local eateries that define the after-hours experience for Bennies in Saint Joseph.

cards.title: Midnight Study at Clemens
cards.subtitle: Main campus library for the College of Saint Benedict
cards.notes: Utilize the quiet study floors and group rooms available until midnight most weeknights during the academic semester.
cards.short_summary: The primary academic hub for late-night research and group projects on the Saint Benedict campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Clemens Library is open Monday through Thursday from 8:00 a.m. to 12 Midnight and Sunday from 10:00 a.m. to 12 Midnight.
cards.source_title: Hours & Locations | Libraries - CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM Sunday-Thursday during the academic year.

cards.title: Late-Night Slices at Gary's
cards.subtitle: Local pizzeria in downtown Saint Joseph
cards.notes: Order a signature pizza for pickup or delivery until 1:30 AM on weekends, a staple for late-night student hunger.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing local pizza shop known for serving the Saint Benedict community well into the early morning hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Gary's Pizza in St. Joseph is open until 1:30 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.source_title: Gary's Pizza - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:30 AM on Friday and Saturday; 10:00 PM on other nights.

cards.title: Dinner at Gorecki
cards.subtitle: Main dining hall at College of Saint Benedict
cards.notes: Visit the various food stations including the Mongolian Grill and pizza bar for a full meal before evening study sessions.
cards.short_summary: The central all-you-care-to-eat dining facility on the CSB campus serving students until 8:00 PM daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Gorecki Dining Center is open daily from 7:00 AM (9:00 AM weekends) until 8:00 PM.
cards.source_title: CSB Culinary Services | Campus Dining, Menus & Hours
cards.access_notes: Open until 8:00 PM daily during the academic year.

cards.title: Evening Snacks at Sexton
cards.subtitle: Student center dining at Saint John's University
cards.notes: Take the Link bus to SJU for a la carte snacks and grilled items available until 9:00 PM in the student center.
cards.short_summary: A popular retail dining location on the SJU campus frequently visited by CSB students via the inter-campus shuttle.
cards.evidence_claim: Sexton Commons Dining is open daily from 10:30 AM to 9:00 PM.
cards.source_title: SJU Where to eat on campus | SJU Culinary Services
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM daily; accessible via the free Link shuttle bus.

cards.title: The Late-Night Link
cards.subtitle: Inter-campus shuttle between CSB and SJU
cards.notes: Catch the free shuttle between campuses, which runs until midnight on weeknights and 2:00 AM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: The essential transportation link connecting the sister campuses of Saint Benedict and Saint John's.
cards.evidence_claim: The Link shuttle runs on an easy-to-remember schedule during evenings, with residence halls open until midnight weeknights and 2 AM weekends.
cards.source_title: Our Unique Partnership | CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: Free for students; runs until 12:00 AM or 2:00 AM depending on the day.

cards.title: Late-Night Workouts at McGlynn
cards.subtitle: Athletic facility at Saint John's University
cards.notes: Burn off stress with a late-night gym session at the Warner Palaestra, open until 10:00 PM most nights.
cards.short_summary: The primary fitness facility for the joint campus community, offering evening hours for student athletes and recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: McGlynn Fitness Center is open Monday-Thursday until 10:00 PM and Sunday until 10:00 PM.
cards.source_title: McGlynn Fitness Center - Saint John's University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM Sunday-Thursday during the academic year.

cards.title: Evening Subs at Bo Diddley's
cards.subtitle: Deli and sandwich shop in Saint Joseph
cards.notes: Grab a signature sub or a bowl of homemade soup for an early evening meal in downtown St. Joseph until 8:00 PM.
cards.short_summary: A local favorite for award-winning sandwiches and a casual atmosphere near the CSB campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Bo Diddley's St. Joseph location is open Monday through Sunday from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
cards.source_title: St. Joe Location — Bo Diddley's Deli
cards.access_notes: Open until 8:00 PM daily.

cards.title: Italian Dinner at Bello Cucina
cards.subtitle: Italian steakhouse in downtown Saint Joseph
cards.notes: Enjoy a sit-down Italian dinner with friends until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.short_summary: A more formal dining option in downtown St. Joseph, popular for student celebrations and weekend dinners.
cards.evidence_claim: Bello Cucina is open until 9:00 PM Tuesday-Thursday and until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Hours | Bello Cucina Italian Steakhouse
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM on weekends; closed Mondays.

cards.title: Late Bites at Neighbors
cards.subtitle: Casual restaurant on the edge of Saint Joseph
cards.notes: Visit for a late-night burger or appetizer, with the kitchen serving until 10:00 PM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A local grill offering a full menu for students looking for a meal just off the main campus corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The kitchen at Neighbors Route 75 is open until 9:00 PM Sunday-Thursday and 10:00 PM Friday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Neighbors Route 75 - Food & Drinks - St Joseph MN
cards.access_notes: Kitchen open until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: Evening Projects at the Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Creative lab in Clemens Library
cards.notes: Work on creative projects or class assignments using specialized tools until 8:00 PM most weeknights.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative space for students to experiment and build, located within the main CSB library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Clemens Library Makerspace is open Monday through Thursday from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM and Sunday from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Libraries | CSB+SJU - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Open until 8:00 PM Sunday-Thursday.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional study nooks, creative labs, and social lounges that define daily life at the College of Saint Benedict beyond the standard tour route.

cards.title: Clemens Library Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Creative Lab in Clemens Library
cards.notes: Access 3D printers, laser cutters, and vinyl tools for class projects or personal hobbies. Mentors are available to help you navigate the fabrication equipment.
cards.short_summary: A technology-rich learning lab for fabrication and iterative design.
cards.evidence_claim: The Makerspace is located in Clemens Library and is free for all CSB and SJU students to use for class or personal projects.
cards.source_title: Clemens Library Makerspace - CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 12pm-8pm, Friday 12pm-6pm, and Sunday 4pm-8pm during the academic year.

cards.title: O'Connell's Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Social Hub in Haehn Campus Center
cards.notes: Relax in this reimagined social space featuring comfortable seating and a stage for student performances. It is a central spot for casual meetups between classes.
cards.short_summary: A renovated student lounge and performance space in the campus center.
cards.evidence_claim: O'Connell's Student Lounge is a facility in the Haehn Campus Center used for student social gatherings and receptions.
cards.source_title: Haehn Campus Center | CSB Events and Catering
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Haehn Campus Center operating hours; often used for student club events.

cards.title: Gorecki Fireside Lounge
cards.subtitle: Cozy Gathering Spot in Gorecki Center
cards.notes: Find a spot by the fireplace for a quiet conversation or a quick study break. This lounge is a primary location for campus-approved student solicitations and tabling.
cards.short_summary: A modern lounge area with a fireplace located in the main dining center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fireside Lounge in the Gorecki Center features lounge seating for 55 and is a designated area for student solicitation activities.
cards.source_title: Facility Guide | CSB Events and Catering
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of the Gorecki Dining and Conference Center.

cards.title: BAC Gallery Lounge
cards.subtitle: Artistic Study Space in Benedicta Arts Center
cards.notes: Study surrounded by rotating art exhibitions in this quiet lounge. It offers a more contemplative atmosphere than the main library or campus center.
cards.short_summary: A quiet lounge and exhibition space within the performing arts center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gallery Lounge in the Benedicta Arts Center (BAC) serves as a reception and student gathering space with a capacity of 40.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Art - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Open during Benedicta Arts Center hours; check for occasional private receptions.

cards.title: Multicultural Center
cards.subtitle: Inclusive Space in Murray Hall
cards.notes: Visit this dedicated space for meeting, programming, and support services. It is a hub for first-generation students and various cultural organizations on campus.
cards.short_summary: A central hub for multicultural student services and inclusive programming.
cards.evidence_claim: The Multicultural Center is located in Murray Hall and provides meeting and programming space for diverse student groups.
cards.source_title: Multicultural Student Services | CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: Located in Murray Hall; home to the First-Generation Organization and International Student Services.

cards.title: Lottie Hall Rotunda
cards.subtitle: Circular Lounge in Lottie Hall
cards.notes: Meet friends in this bright, circular lounge featuring comfortable armchairs. It is a signature architectural feature and social anchor for sophomore residents.
cards.short_summary: A spacious, bright circular lounge area within a sophomore residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Lottie Hall features a rotunda described as a spacious, bright lounge area with armchairs arranged in a circle.
cards.source_title: Lottie Hall | CSB Residential Life
cards.access_notes: Primarily for residents, but common areas are often accessible for student visitors.

cards.title: McGlynn's Sports Cafe
cards.subtitle: Casual Eatery in Haehn Campus Center
cards.notes: Grab a quick meal or snack in this sports-themed cafe. It is a popular alternative to the main dining hall for students looking for a casual atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A women's sports-themed cafe offering casual dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: McGlynn's Sports Cafe is located in the Haehn Campus Center and features a menu developed with student input.
cards.source_title: Haehn Campus Center | CSB Events and Catering
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch and dinner; check seasonal hours for late-night availability.

cards.title: HAB Glass Walkway
cards.subtitle: Scenic Connection at Henrita Academic Building
cards.notes: Walk through this glassed-in bridge connecting HAB and Richarda Hall. It provides a bright, weather-protected path with views of the campus grounds.
cards.short_summary: An above-ground glass walkway connecting two major academic buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: A glassed-in walkway connects the Henrita Academic Building (HAB) and Richarda Hall above ground.
cards.source_title: Henrita Academic Building and Richarda Hall | CSB Archives
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; provides a scenic route between classes.

cards.title: Clemens Library Stacks
cards.subtitle: Quiet Study Zone in Clemens Library
cards.notes: Head to the stacks area for the most focused, silent study environment on campus. It is the designated 'Quiet Study' zone for deep concentration.
cards.short_summary: The designated silent study area located within the library book stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Clemens Library Space Usage Policy designates the Stacks Area as the 'Quiet Study' zone.
cards.source_title: Space Usage Policy | Libraries - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Available during library hours; silence is strictly enforced in this area.

cards.title: CSB Fish Pond
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Study Spot near Main Building
cards.notes: Study by the water and watch the resident Koi fish during warmer months. It is a peaceful outdoor retreat known for the annual 'Parade of Fish' tradition.
cards.short_summary: A scenic outdoor pond area used for relaxation and study.
cards.evidence_claim: The pond is a popular place for student activities and a study spot, home to Koi fish in the warm seasons.
cards.source_title: Fish Pond | CSB Archives - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public space; best visited during spring and fall when the fish are present.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover free social spaces and activities at the College of Saint Benedict, from serene monastic trails to creative makerspaces and art galleries.

cards.title: Hike the Monastic Woods
cards.subtitle: Serene trails behind the monastery
cards.notes: Explore miles of wooded paths including the Trillium Trail. These private monastic grounds are open to the public from dawn to dusk for quiet reflection and nature walks.
cards.short_summary: Quiet wooded hiking trails located on the monastery grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The grounds include serene gardens, outdoor Stations of the Cross, a labyrinth, and three shrines. The grounds are open during the day from dawn to dusk.
cards.source_title: Visit the Monastery - Sisters of St. Benedict
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk; no pets allowed on monastic trails.

cards.title: Create in the Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Creative lab in Clemens Library
cards.notes: Use 3D printers, sewing machines, and crafting tools for personal or class projects. Staff provide free training and assistance for all skill levels during open hours.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative creative lab offering free access to tools and technology.
cards.evidence_claim: The Makerspace is a creative learning lab where CSB and SJU community members can explore ideas, experiment, design, and build... free of charge.
cards.source_title: Makerspace | CSB+SJU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 12pm-8pm, Friday 12pm-6pm, and Sunday 4pm-8pm.

cards.title: Browse the Gorecki Gallery
cards.subtitle: Art exhibitions in the BAC
cards.notes: Visit the Benedicta Arts Center to view rotating exhibitions of professional and student work. The gallery is open to the public and requires no admission fee.
cards.short_summary: A professional exhibition space featuring diverse visual arts.
cards.evidence_claim: The gallery is open from Monday through Friday from 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. There is no admission charge.
cards.source_title: Visual Arts | Fine Arts - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 10am-4pm during the academic year.

cards.title: Swim at Lake Sagatagan
cards.subtitle: Campus beach and swimming area
cards.notes: Enjoy free swimming and non-motorized watercraft rentals with a student ID. The beach is a popular social spot during the warmer months for Bennies and Johnnies.
cards.short_summary: A private campus beach offering free swimming and boat rentals for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Rentals and swimming are free for College of Saint Benedict and Saint John's University students, faculty, staff, and alumni.
cards.source_title: Lake Sagatagan | OutdoorU
cards.access_notes: Open daily 11am-6:30pm during summer; accessible via the Link bus from CSB.

cards.title: Relax by the Gorecki Fireplace
cards.subtitle: Cozy social hub in Gorecki Center
cards.notes: Gather with friends in the comfortable lounge area featuring a large stone fireplace. It is a central meeting spot for students waiting for the inter-campus bus.
cards.short_summary: A warm, central lounge area ideal for socializing and studying.
cards.evidence_claim: The facility includes two lobby areas, a fireplace social area, an outdoor patio space and large windows throughout.
cards.source_title: Gorecki Center | CSB Events and Catering
cards.access_notes: Open during building operating hours; typically late night during the academic term.

cards.title: Workout at the HCC
cards.subtitle: Student fitness and recreation
cards.notes: Access cardio equipment, free weights, and the swimming pool for free with your Bennie card. The center also hosts free group fitness classes like yoga and Pilates.
cards.short_summary: A comprehensive fitness facility free for all enrolled students.
cards.evidence_claim: Each of our campuses has a fitness center as well as a pool... Personal trainers are available to create free individualized training programs.
cards.source_title: Athletics & Recreation | CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: Student ID required for entry; check website for current semester hours.

cards.title: Visit the Monastery Garden
cards.subtitle: Peaceful outdoor courtyard
cards.notes: Walk through the beautifully landscaped gardens and sit by the historic fountain. This quiet outdoor space is perfect for meditation or reading between classes.
cards.short_summary: A historic and tranquil garden space on the monastery grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The grounds include serene gardens, outdoor Stations of the Cross, a labyrinth, and three shrines.
cards.source_title: Monastery Garden and Fountain | CSB Archives
cards.access_notes: Open to the public daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Study in Clemens Library
cards.subtitle: Collaborative and quiet study zones
cards.notes: Reserve a private study room or find a spot in the open lounges. The library offers free Wi-Fi and public desktop access for research and group projects.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus library offering diverse free study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: Visitors have several options for accessing computers... connect to the guest Wi-Fi to access online library content.
cards.source_title: Guest Information | Libraries - CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: Open late during academic terms; check library website for specific daily hours.

cards.title: Hang Out on the Mall
cards.subtitle: Central campus green space
cards.notes: The large lawn between academic buildings is the site of free student events, outdoor concerts, and casual frisbee games during the spring and fall.
cards.short_summary: The main outdoor gathering space for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Supported spaces... CSB Mall. CSB Mall Stage. CSB South Lawn.
cards.source_title: Classrooms and Spaces | IT Services
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space year-round.

cards.title: Tour Sacred Heart Chapel
cards.subtitle: Historic monastic architecture
cards.notes: Visit the centerpiece of the monastery to admire the architecture and stained glass. Guided tours are available for free, or you can visit for quiet reflection.
cards.short_summary: A historic chapel offering free tours and a space for quiet reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Guided tours are offered... Tuesday – Friday 10:00 a.m., 11:00 a.m., 1:00 p.m., and 2:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Visit the Monastery - Sisters of St. Benedict
cards.access_notes: Guided tours available Tuesday-Sunday; check website for specific times and blackout dates.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Discover the most effective study environments across the College of Saint Benedict campus, from silent library stacks to collaborative makerspaces and sunlit lounges.

cards.title: Silent Stacks in Clemens
cards.subtitle: Quiet Study Zone
cards.notes: Head to the stacks area for a strictly quiet environment. This zone is designated for deep focus and individual research without the distraction of group conversations.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet study zone located within the book stacks of Clemens Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Clemens Library designates the Stacks Area specifically for Quiet Study to support focused academic work.
cards.source_title: Space Usage Policy | Libraries - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; the stacks are accessible to all students for silent individual study.

cards.title: Collaborative Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Active Learning Hub
cards.notes: Utilize this creative lab for group projects and hands-on design. It is an active learning zone where collaboration and experimentation are encouraged.
cards.short_summary: A creative learning lab in Clemens Library designed for collaborative projects and innovation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Clemens Library Makerspace is an 'Active Learning' zone where community members can explore ideas and build projects.
cards.source_title: Space Usage Policy | Libraries - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Specific hours apply: Mon-Thu 12pm-8pm, Fri 12pm-6pm, Sun 4pm-8pm.

cards.title: Fireside Study at Gorecki
cards.subtitle: Social Study Space
cards.notes: Find a spot near the fireplace for a comfortable, social study session. This lobby area is ideal for casual reading or meeting between classes.
cards.short_summary: A comfortable lobby area with a fireplace located in the Gorecki Dining and Conference Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gorecki Dining Center includes a fireplace social area and lobby utilized by students for gathering and study.
cards.source_title: Gorecki Dining Center | CSB Archives - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Gorecki Center operating hours; popular for students waiting for the inter-campus bus.

cards.title: Modern Lounges in HAB
cards.subtitle: Academic Breakout Space
cards.notes: Take advantage of the renovated lounges in the Henrita Academic Building. These spaces feature modern furniture and natural light for a productive atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: Modernized lounge areas with new furniture and windows in the Henrita Academic Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Renovations in 2018-2019 introduced modern lounge furniture and increased natural light to the Henrita Academic Building.
cards.source_title: Henrita Academic Building and Richarda Hall | CSB Archives
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; located on the main level near classrooms.

cards.title: Lottie Hall Rotunda
cards.subtitle: Residential Study Lounge
cards.notes: Study in the bright, circular rotunda lounge. The armchairs and open layout make it a welcoming spot for residents to focus on coursework.
cards.short_summary: A spacious and bright circular lounge area located within Lottie Residence Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Lottie Hall features a Rotunda lounge described as a spacious, bright area with armchairs for student use.
cards.source_title: Lottie Hall | CSB Residential Life - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Primarily for residents of Lottie Hall; accessible 24/7 for students with building access.

cards.title: Private Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Group Reservation Space
cards.notes: Book a private room for up to two hours to work on group assignments. Reservations are highly recommended to guarantee a spot during busy times.
cards.short_summary: Private, reservable rooms in Clemens Library for group or individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: Clemens Library offers reservable study rooms for up to 2 hours per reservation for students and faculty.
cards.source_title: Space Usage Policy | Libraries - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Reservations can be made online; rooms are restricted to CSB/SJU students and staff.

cards.title: BAC Music Library
cards.subtitle: Specialized Arts Study
cards.notes: Study surrounded by musical scores and recordings. This specialized library offers a unique, quiet atmosphere within the Benedicta Arts Center.
cards.short_summary: A specialized music library located within the Benedicta Arts Center (BAC).
cards.evidence_claim: The Benedicta Arts Center (BAC) houses a music library as part of its academic arts facilities.
cards.source_title: Buildings - CSB+SJU - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Open during BAC academic hours; check for specific music library operating times.

cards.title: Science Center Plaza
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Study Area
cards.notes: Enjoy the fresh air at the plaza between Clemens Library and the Science Center. It is a great spot for outdoor study during warmer months.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor plaza area located between the Ardolf Science Center and Clemens Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ardolf Science Center was designed with a plaza created between it and the Clemens Library.
cards.source_title: Ardolf Science Center | CSB Archives - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space; best used during daylight hours.

cards.title: Haehn Center Atrium
cards.subtitle: High-Traffic Study Spot
cards.notes: Study in the heart of campus activity. The atrium provides plenty of seating and is close to dining options like McGlynn's and O'Connell's.
cards.short_summary: A central atrium in the Haehn Campus Center (HCC) used for gathering and study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Haehn Campus Center (HCC) Atrium is listed as a supported space for student use and gathering.
cards.source_title: College of Saint Benedict and Saint John's University Supported Spaces
cards.access_notes: Open during HCC hours; can be noisy during peak meal times.

cards.title: Teresa Reception Center
cards.subtitle: Historic Study Setting
cards.notes: Study in one of the campus's most historic buildings. The reception center offers a quiet, formal atmosphere for reading and writing.
cards.short_summary: A reception and gathering area located in the historic Teresa Hall of the Main Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Main Building's Teresa Hall includes the Teresa Reception Center, used as a gathering location for students.
cards.source_title: Buildings - CSB+SJU - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Main Building hours; typically a quieter area of campus.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the essential streets and corridors of Saint Joseph, Minnesota, where the College of Saint Benedict community shops, dines, and gathers just steps from the campus gates.

cards.title: Coffee and Community
cards.subtitle: Minnesota Street West
cards.notes: Visit this community-focused coffee shop for organic, locally sourced lattes and baked goods in a cozy, artsy atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A central coffee shop on Minnesota Street West known for its organic menu and student-friendly environment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Local Blend is located at 19 West Minnesota Street and features organic, locally sourced ingredients for its coffee and food.
cards.source_title: The Local Blend: Home
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 6:30 AM or 7:00 AM until 4:00 PM.

cards.title: Local Food and Art Co-op
cards.subtitle: Minnesota Street West
cards.notes: Browse this member-owned co-op for fresh local produce and unique handmade items from over two dozen regional artists.
cards.short_summary: A community-owned food and art co-op located directly across from the CSB campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Minnesota Street Market is a food and art co-op that carries groceries and local artisan products on Minnesota Street.
cards.source_title: Bonner Leader Program | CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: Located in the downtown district across from the CSB campus.

cards.title: Classic Town Breakfast
cards.subtitle: College Avenue North
cards.notes: Stop by this local staple for a traditional breakfast or lunch just a few blocks north of the main campus entrance.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing local restaurant on College Avenue North known for its breakfast menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Kay's Kitchen is located at 303 College Ave N and is recognized as a top breakfast spot in Saint Joseph.
cards.source_title: Kay's Kitchen
cards.access_notes: Open for breakfast and lunch service.

cards.title: Historic Butcher Shop
cards.subtitle: 1st Avenue NW
cards.notes: Experience a local tradition at this butcher shop, famous for its creatively flavored brats and nostalgic small-town vibe.
cards.short_summary: A historic meat market in downtown Saint Joseph that has been in business since 1909.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Joseph Meat Market is located at 26 1st Ave NW and is known for its wide variety of brats and beef sticks.
cards.source_title: St. Joseph Meat Market
cards.access_notes: Retail store is open to the public during standard business hours.

cards.title: Handcrafted Desserts
cards.subtitle: College Avenue North
cards.notes: Enjoy small-batch, handcrafted ice cream with unique flavors at this popular dessert destination near the campus edge.
cards.short_summary: A local ice cream shop on College Avenue North offering handcrafted frozen treats.
cards.evidence_claim: Jupiter Moon Ice Cream is a highlighted dessert destination in downtown Saint Joseph.
cards.source_title: Jupiter Moon Ice Cream
cards.access_notes: Seasonal and standard hours vary; check official site for current schedule.

cards.title: Italian Dining
cards.subtitle: Minnesota Street East
cards.notes: Visit this Italian restaurant for pasta and specialty dishes in a refined setting along the main downtown corridor.
cards.short_summary: An Italian restaurant located on the eastern end of the Minnesota Street downtown strip.
cards.evidence_claim: Bello Cucina is located at 15 E Minnesota St and offers Italian cuisine.
cards.source_title: Bello Cucina
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch and dinner service.

cards.title: Modern American Fare
cards.subtitle: 2nd Avenue NW
cards.notes: Dine on modern American dishes at this restaurant located just off the main Minnesota Street thoroughfare.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant on 2nd Avenue NW providing a variety of food and tap options.
cards.evidence_claim: The House Food and Tap is located at 13 2nd Ave NW in Saint Joseph.
cards.source_title: The House Food and Tap
cards.access_notes: Open for regular dining hours; under-21 safe for food service.

cards.title: Louisiana-Style Cuisine
cards.subtitle: Minnesota Street West
cards.notes: Taste authentic New Orleans-inspired dishes at this vibrant restaurant located in the heart of Joe Town.
cards.short_summary: A Louisiana-style restaurant on Minnesota Street West known for its Cajun and Creole flavors.
cards.evidence_claim: KREWE is a restaurant in Saint Joseph offering Louisiana-style dinner options.
cards.source_title: KREWE
cards.access_notes: Open for dinner service; reservations often recommended.

cards.title: Off-Campus Living Corridor
cards.subtitle: 4th Avenue SE
cards.notes: Walk this residential corridor to see popular off-campus housing options used by upperclassmen Bennies and Johnnies.
cards.short_summary: A residential area on 4th Avenue SE featuring apartment complexes for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Graceview Estates is located at 401 4th Ave SE and is listed as off-campus housing near the CSB campus.
cards.source_title: Off-Campus Housing near CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: Public street access; residential buildings are private.

cards.title: Student Supply Run
cards.subtitle: Elm Street East
cards.notes: Head to this full-service grocery store for dorm essentials and fresh food, located on the eastern edge of town.
cards.short_summary: The primary grocery store serving the Saint Joseph and CSB community.
cards.evidence_claim: Coborn's is located at 1500 Elm St E and serves as a major grocery provider for the area.
cards.source_title: Coborn's Grocery
cards.access_notes: Open daily with extended hours for grocery shopping.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and longstanding traditions that define the Bennie experience at the College of Saint Benedict.

cards.title: The First and Last Dinner
cards.subtitle: A Bennie's journey in light
cards.notes: Bennies gather for candle-lighting during their first and last shared dinners as a class, symbolizing the school motto 'Let your light shine.'
cards.short_summary: A ritual marking the beginning and end of a student's time at CSB.
cards.evidence_claim: CSB's candle-lighting ceremonies mark the first and last dinner Bennies share together as a class, bringing to life the motto 'Let your light shine.'
cards.source_title: Traditions at CSB+SJU - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Held annually for the incoming first-year class and the graduating senior class.

cards.title: Celebrating Sisterhood
cards.subtitle: Homecoming week's signature event
cards.notes: Started in 1999, this day celebrates Bennie pride with custom t-shirts and events focused on the unique identity of the women's college.
cards.short_summary: An annual celebration of the Bennie identity held during Homecoming week.
cards.evidence_claim: Bennie Day was started in 1999 by students as a counter-program to SJU's Hot Bread Night and has been celebrated every year since.
cards.source_title: Bennie Day celebrates 25th anniversary on Oct. 3 | CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: Open to all current students and alumnae during Homecoming week.

cards.title: A First-Class Feast
cards.subtitle: Gorecki Center's December tradition
cards.notes: Students enjoy a formal, buffet-style meal including prime rib and a chocolate fountain before the winter semester break.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding formal dinner for students held every December.
cards.evidence_claim: The CSB Holiday Dinner has been a tradition for over 35 years, serving over 1,000 students a formal meal in the Gorecki Center.
cards.source_title: Students dine first-class at annual CSB Holiday Dinner | CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: Held in the Gorecki Dining and Conference Center for CSB and SJU students.

cards.title: Pearsistance is Key
cards.subtitle: Springtime athletic puns
cards.notes: This annual spring triathlon is famous for its fruit-themed puns and promotes wellness through friendly competition.
cards.short_summary: A student triathlon known for its humorous fruit-based themes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fruit-at-the-Finish Triathlon is a springtime tradition featuring themes like 'PrePEAR to Win' and 'Rind Over Matter.'
cards.source_title: Traditions at CSB+SJU - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Open to student participants; registration typically required.

cards.title: Lighting the Mall
cards.subtitle: A community winter gathering
cards.notes: The community gathers on the CSB Mall between Clemens Library and Ardolf Science Center for the annual lighting of a large white pine.
cards.short_summary: An annual ceremony to light the campus Christmas tree on the CSB Mall.
cards.evidence_claim: The CSB Christmas tree lighting takes place annually at the CSB Mall, often featuring a tree harvested from the campus grounds.
cards.source_title: Christmas tree lightings help spread the joy of the season | CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: Public event held outdoors on the CSB Mall in late November or early December.

cards.title: Blessing of the Hands
cards.subtitle: Transition to the profession
cards.notes: Graduating nursing students receive their pins and participate in a 'Blessing of the Hands' ritual rooted in Benedictine values.
cards.short_summary: A symbolic ceremony for nursing graduates marking their entry into the field.
cards.evidence_claim: The annual Pinning Ceremony for CSB/SJU nursing graduates includes a presentation of pins and a Blessing of the Hands.
cards.source_title: Nursing Pinning Ceremony 2021
cards.access_notes: Held annually in May for graduating nursing seniors and their families.

cards.title: The Inter-Campus Commute
cards.subtitle: Connecting Bennies and Johnnies
cards.notes: The free shuttle bus service between CSB and SJU is a daily tradition for students, facilitating the integrated partnership of the two schools.
cards.short_summary: The essential shuttle service connecting the two separate campuses.
cards.evidence_claim: The LINK is a free shuttle that runs continually between the CSB and SJU campuses, a core part of the schools' unique partnership.
cards.source_title: Our Unique Partnership | CSB+SJU - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Free for students with ID; runs on a continuous schedule during class times.

cards.title: Gratitude in Guild Hall
cards.subtitle: A 40-year fall tradition
cards.notes: Held the week before break, faculty and staff serve a traditional turkey dinner to students in a family-style setting.
cards.short_summary: An annual pre-Thanksgiving feast served by the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: The annual Thanksgiving Student Dinner has been held for over 42 years, with faculty and staff helping serve the meal.
cards.source_title: SJU Thanksgiving Dinner 2023
cards.access_notes: Held in Guild Hall at SJU for both Bennie and Johnnie students.

cards.title: Embracing the Cold
cards.subtitle: A month of winter activities
cards.notes: This festival features broomball, ice fishing, and a luminary walk across Lake Sagatagan to the Stella Maris Chapel.
cards.short_summary: A winter celebration featuring traditional outdoor Minnesota activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The True North Winter Festival includes activities like broomball, ice fishing, and the annual Luminary Walk to Stella Maris Chapel.
cards.source_title: Inaugural True North Winter Festival offers month-long lineup of winter fun at CSB and SJU
cards.access_notes: Events take place across both campuses throughout February.

cards.title: The Final Goodbye
cards.subtitle: A student-only celebration
cards.notes: A dedicated event for the graduating class to gather one last time before commencement, organized by student leadership.
cards.short_summary: The final social gathering for seniors before graduation.
cards.evidence_claim: Senior Farewell is an annual event for graduating students held in the final stretch before commencement.
cards.source_title: Event Schedule - Commencement - College of Saint Benedict
cards.access_notes: Restricted to graduating seniors; typically held in May.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at College of Saint Benedict, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A guide to the essential first-weekend experiences for new Bennies, from orientation traditions to exploring the twin campuses.

cards.title: Move-In and Unpack
cards.subtitle: Wednesday Morning Arrival
cards.notes: Arrive between 7:30 and 10:30 a.m. to meet your orientation leaders and move into your new home. Label all boxes with your name and room number for a smoother process.
cards.short_summary: The official start of the fall semester begins with morning move-in for first-year and transfer students.
cards.evidence_claim: Move-in day for CSB first-year and transfer students is Wednesday, August 26, 2026, from 7:30 a.m. to 10:30 a.m.
cards.source_title: Fall Move-In Information | CSB Residential Life
cards.access_notes: Check-in occurs at designated residence hall unloading areas.

cards.title: Welcome & Blessing Service
cards.subtitle: A Shared Spiritual Start
cards.notes: Join fellow students and families for an ecumenical prayer service. This tradition marks the transition from family move-in to the start of your independent student journey.
cards.short_summary: An ecumenical prayer service held in the Sacred Heart Chapel to welcome new students and their families.
cards.evidence_claim: All new students and families are invited to the 'Welcome & Blessing Prayer Service' in the Sacred Heart Chapel before the Basecamp program begins.
cards.source_title: Fall Move-In Information | CSB Residential Life
cards.access_notes: Open to all faiths; families typically depart following this service.

cards.title: Fuel Up at Gorecki
cards.subtitle: First Weekend Meals
cards.notes: Visit the Mongolian Grill or the pasta bar for your first campus meals. Weekend hours typically start at 9:00 a.m. for brunch, a popular time for new students to gather.
cards.short_summary: The primary dining hall at CSB offering all-you-care-to-eat buffet stations including international and homestyle fare.
cards.evidence_claim: Gorecki Dining Center is open 9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. on weekends during the school year.
cards.source_title: Cuisine Unseen: Gorecki Center Can Satisfy All Cravings
cards.access_notes: Accepts meal passes, dining bucks, cash, and credit cards.

cards.title: Ride the LINK to SJU
cards.subtitle: Connecting the Twin Campuses
cards.notes: Hop on the free shuttle for a 10-minute ride to Saint John's University. It's the easiest way to explore the 'other half' of your campus community during orientation.
cards.short_summary: A free shuttle service that connects the College of Saint Benedict and Saint John's University campuses.
cards.evidence_claim: The LINK is a free shuttle that runs on a regular schedule during weekends, providing a 10-minute commute between campuses.
cards.source_title: Our Unique Partnership | CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: Free for all students with a valid ID; runs continually during the day.

cards.title: Afternoon at the Beach
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Relaxation at SJU
cards.notes: Take the LINK to SJU and walk to the beach. It's a prime spot for swimming or canoeing during the warm first weekend of the fall semester.
cards.short_summary: A private beach on the Saint John's campus available for use by the CSB and SJU community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Saint John's Abbey beach is a private beach for SJU and CSB students; swimming is allowed during designated beach hours.
cards.source_title: Explore On Your Own | OutdoorU
cards.access_notes: Check in with lifeguards upon arrival; open to students and their guests.

cards.title: Explore the Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Creative Weekend Projects
cards.notes: Visit the library to check out the Makerspace. It's a great place to experiment with 3D printing or creative tools before the academic rush begins.
cards.short_summary: The main library at CSB, featuring a collaborative Makerspace for student innovation and experimentation.
cards.evidence_claim: Clemens Library Makerspace is open Sundays from 4:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. during the academic year.
cards.source_title: Libraries | CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: Located within Clemens Library; open to all CSB/SJU students.

cards.title: Socialize at O'Connell's
cards.subtitle: Evening Hangout Spot
cards.notes: Head to the Haehn Campus Center to relax in the lounge. It's a central hub for meeting new friends and participating in evening orientation social events.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge located in the Haehn Campus Center used for recreation and social gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Haehn Campus Center includes O'Connell's Student Lounge as a facility for student recreational purposes.
cards.source_title: Haehn Campus Center | CSB Events and Catering
cards.access_notes: Open during campus center hours; residence halls are open until 2 a.m. on weekends.

cards.title: Quiet Time in the Garden
cards.subtitle: Reflective Sunday Walk
cards.notes: Take a peaceful stroll through the Sisters' Garden near the Monastery. It's a quiet space to reflect on your first few days of college life.
cards.short_summary: A tranquil garden area located on the grounds of Saint Benedict's Monastery adjacent to the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Monastery grounds include the Sister's Garden and Common Ground Garden, which are part of the local landscape.
cards.source_title: Saint Benedict's Monastery Map
cards.access_notes: Visitors are asked to be respectful of the monastic community's privacy.

cards.title: Late Night Snack
cards.subtitle: Casual Dining at Haehn
cards.notes: Grab a burger or a quick snack at McGlynn's. It's a popular alternative to the main dining hall for a casual weekend dinner with your orientation group.
cards.short_summary: A made-to-order cafe located in the Haehn Campus Center offering burgers, pizza, and subs.
cards.evidence_claim: McGlynn's Sports Cafe is located in the Haehn Campus Center and offers a variety of casual food options.
cards.source_title: CSB Culinary Services | Dining Hours
cards.access_notes: Check current semester hours for late-night availability; typically closed during summer breaks.

cards.title: Candle-Lighting Tradition
cards.subtitle: Let Your Light Shine
cards.notes: Participate in this signature tradition where the light is passed from alumnae to new students. It marks your official entry into the Bennie community.
cards.short_summary: A foundational tradition at CSB where students light candles to symbolize the start of their college journey.
cards.evidence_claim: The candle-lighting ceremony marks the first dinner Bennies share together as a class, bringing to life the motto 'Let your light shine.'
cards.source_title: Traditions at CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: Typically held during the first-year orientation dinner.
